assessmentPlan: Only prospective cumulative 128/512-pair looks. Existing SR-024 paired-normal rule with family alpha .05/2^contrastIndex, Bonferroni across looks, minimum 20 pairs on each side, 2.5-SE sensitivity, bounded-pair reporting and nonbinding computational futility. No block looks, post-close extension, retuning or selective replay. Explicit owner acceptance remains separate.
baselineProvenance: Frozen engine-core.jar copied before O2/O1 modifications, SHA256 9b41d6b174846cfaf3af9f3089d8c3d13b0614fbf0a4717a6fe46aec346c61d9. Shared new research-only launcher. See uci-preflight-v1.json. Version finalization remains blocked independently; no release identity claim.
selectionRationale: Select completed-hint policy 4 in the four-worker ROOT_REUSE domain against the unchanged accepted champion. The complete 32-pair development screen scored 33 W / 14 D / 17 L (+88.74 Elo; descriptive normal 95% interval +22.03 to +162.64, bounded interval crossing zero), with all normal games and audits passed and 4.39% more full-process CPU under equal clocks. Earlier semantic, exact-reference, legal-hint, ownership and 2/4/16-worker lifecycle checks passed. History retention and filtering experiments are intentionally unsupported above one worker, so their pending one-worker ablations do not select this domain. The development signal and measured cost justify fresh confirmation; they do not authorize adoption.

confirmationForecast.interpretation: Plug-in variance and time forecasts from selected development data, not guaranteed power. Five losing pairs out of 32 imply only 20 below-half pairs at 128 in expectation; required two-sided normal eligibility is uncertain, so the bounded rule may require continuation despite a strong signal. At 512 pairs the adjusted normal score half-width is about 0.033, roughly 24 Elo locally. No small-gain power claim. Add roughly 5-10% preflight/session overhead. Run the first 128-pair scheduled look, then use its predeclared decision and observed workstation headroom for continuation windows; no post-close extension. One game at a time, four Search workers per request, BelowNormal, 512 MiB heap per engine. Workstation samples showed 23-29% total CPU and over 16 GiB free, but are incomplete. No automatic disruptive 12-hour run.

preparationInput: Only input to prepare_confirmation.py. The development openings path identifies the pinned source book/receipt; the freezer replaces it with fresh partition-one stage schedules. This file is not itself an executable confirmation protocol.
